meta.name: ikigai-focus
meta.description: Analyzes everything the user has been building, writing, and working on — across projects, public writing, and harness activity — plus what's happening in their field and in AI more broadly, to find where fulfillment, capability, and lucrative demand actually overlap for them (ikigai), then recommends a concrete focus, possible domain/name, and how to explain the scattered work as one coherent story. Use when the user feels scattered across too many projects, asks "what should I actually be working on", wants their various projects/writing pulled into one direction, or explicitly mentions ikigai, focus, or career direction confusion.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。
